nodes.label: S3 — conversation token (stage doc, referenced)
nodes.rationale: Found the post-call webhook had never written a row (3 stacked misconfigurations) before the native run, which would otherwise have wrongly implicated WebRTC.

nodes.label: S3 — Conversation ID and v2 Token Route (B3)
D21 — Call the token endpoint with fetch, not the elevenlabs-js SDK
nodes.rationale: The SDK's typed TokenResponseModel omits conversation_id; it survives at runtime only through an untyped passthrough validator, so the one value this stage depends on would be invisible to tsc and could silently vanish in a patch release.

nodes.label: D22 — Missing conversation_id is a 502, never a fallback
nodes.rationale: A derived/made-up row key silently forks a learner's history weeks before anyone notices; a refused session is a visible, immediate, correctable failure.

nodes.label: D23 — One conversation id, two tripwires
nodes.rationale: The token-minted id is seeded before startSession and never overwritten; onConversationMetadata and onConnect only warn on mismatch so a future SDK derivation drift is noticed rather than silently accepted or fatally treated.

nodes.label: D24 — persistTutorSession takes the owner as a parameter
nodes.rationale: The original function resolved ownerId from a cookie, which a Bearer-authenticated v2 route cannot supply; splitting into an owner-scoped core plus a cookie wrapper also moves revalidatePath out of the shared core since the native client refetches instead of relying on Next's data cache.

nodes.label: D25 — CORS added on the v2 namespace, never with credentials
nodes.rationale: React Native fetch does not enforce CORS so it isn't what makes the phone work, but react-native-web/expo start --web and browser-based debugging of the deployed API do hit it; allow-credentials is omitted because Bearer-only auth makes it meaningless and illegal beside origin:*.

nodes.label: D26 — Deploy = push master; Vercel deployment is the phone's target
nodes.rationale: The project, domain, env vars and integrations already existed on Vercel; master was only two commits behind, so 'deploy' reduced to a git push plus setting EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL, and it also disposes of S2 §6's ATS/tunnel concern via real HTTPS.

nodes.label: D27 — One post-call webhook, set at workspace level, no per-agent overrides
nodes.rationale: words-1.2/1.3 inherited a disabled workspace-default webhook pointing at a nonexistent route while words-1.0/1.1 pointed at a dead ngrok tunnel, so no lesson_sessions row had ever been enriched by the webhook; a per-agent override is invisible from the prompt registry and would recur for every future sync:agents-created version, so all four were reset to null and the workspace default repointed at the deployment.

nodes.label: D28 — Mint the token at the moment of connect
nodes.rationale: The LiveKit token lives only 900 seconds, so fetching it at screen mount rather than at the Start tap would expire it for a learner who reads the word list first.

nodes.label: D29 — GET /api/v2/agent-versions returns {versions, defaultVersion}
nodes.rationale: 'Newest active' is a server-side rule (all[all.length-1]); a client re-deriving it from array order would be a second implementation of resolveAgent living in a shipped binary, and agentId is dropped entirely so retiring a version can never brick an installed app.

nodes.label: B3 — WebRTC-derived conversation id may not match the authoritative id
S3 — Conversation Token (research doc)
D22 — token route validates conversation_id before responding
nodes.rationale: Prevents silently persisting a session with no conversation_id; do not add a fallback, check the API response shape first.

nodes.label: D23 — conversationIdRef seeded once before startSession
nodes.rationale: Never written again by a callback; guarantees the client's id can never fork from the token's id.

nodes.label: D24 — persistTutorSessionFor(ownerId, input) refactor
nodes.rationale: One seam every future v2 write follows: auth in the wrapper, cache invalidation only on the cookie path.

nodes.label: D25 — CORS preflight helper (OPTIONS export on every v2 route)
nodes.rationale: Browser (Expo web) preflight fails without an explicit OPTIONS export; iOS is unaffected.

nodes.label: D27 — workspace-level post-call webhook, no per-agent overrides
nodes.rationale: Per-agent overrides quietly defeated a single workspace webhook target; clearing them means any future sync-agents version inherits the webhook automatically.
